title: Metal–organic framework–injectable hydrogel hybrid scaffolds promote accelerated angiogenesis for in vivo tissue engineering
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32143-32154
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02770E, Paper

Sobuj Shahidul Islam, Tatsuya Dode, Soma Kawashima, Myu Fukuoka, Takaaki Tsuruoka, Koji Nagahama
A new type of injectable hydrogel scaffold for in vivo tissue engineering with accelerated angiogenesis was generated by combining L-arginine-loaded MOFs with PLGA-PEG-PLGA/LAPONITE® nanocomposite hydrogel.
